schema: CREATE TABLE branches (branch_id INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, code TEXT(255) NOT NULL);
correct_query: SELECT t.branch_id, t.code, t0.r FROM (SELECT branch_id, code, CAST(code AS INTEGER) AS code_int FROM branches) AS t INNER JOIN (SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY code) AS r FROM branches) AS t0 ON t.code_int = t0.r

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Omits CAST(code AS INTEGER) when joining a TEXT column against a RANK() window function
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT b1.branch_id, b1.code, t2.r FROM branches AS b1 INNER JOIN (SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY code) AS r FROM branches) AS t2 ON b1.code = t2.r
